claims: The Artemis II launch is visible from Florida, Orlando, and parts of southern Georgia shortly after liftoff.
Major broadcast options for the Artemis II launch include NASA+ (desktop and mobile app), NASA's YouTube Channel, Amazon Prime Video, and local news channels.
The Artemis II launch is visible from Central Florida and southern Georgia.
The Artemis II launch is visible in the east for Orlando 10-20 seconds after liftoff.
The Artemis II launch is visible in the east for Tampa 30-40 seconds after liftoff.
The Artemis II launch is visible in the east for Jacksonville 30-40 seconds after liftoff.
The Artemis II rocket will likely be visible for about 70 seconds before exiting the immediate lower atmosphere.
NASA’s YouTube and NASA+ provide continuous coverage of the Artemis II launch, starting early on launch day.
